cast.name: Laurel Mack
cast.role: Grieving mother frozen ten years after her daughter's vanishing
cast.look: A slender 55-year-old British woman with sorrowful hazel eyes, tired posture, chin-length faded blonde hair, wearing a neutral knit cardigan and wool trousers in contemporary London.

cast.name: Floyd Dunn
cast.role: Charming, self-deprecating mathematics professor harboring dark complicity
cast.look: A charismatic 56-year-old man with silver-flecked brown hair, gentle smile, scholarly glasses, wearing an unstructured tweed blazer and soft button-down shirt.

cast.name: Noelle Donnelly
cast.role: Former math tutor whose obsessive entitlement orchestrated the tragedy
cast.look: A plain, intense 40-year-old woman with severe dark hair pulled back tightly, sharp calculating gaze, wearing an unadorned wool coat and modest blouse in 2005.

cast.name: Ellie Mack
cast.role: The fifteen-year-old golden daughter who vanished on her way to the library
cast.look: A luminous 15-year-old British schoolgirl with long golden hair, bright green eyes with a cupid's bow smile, wearing a navy school uniform and canvas bag in 2005.

cast.name: Poppy Dunn

cast.look: A poised, quiet 9-year-old girl with wavy honey-colored hair, distinctive green eyes, head tilted slightly, wearing a neat woolen pinafore dress in a sunny kitchen.

cast.name: Hannah Mack
cast.role: Laurel's surviving elder daughter living in the shadow of her sister's ghost
